answer: Split each newcomer's work through a prism before paid work opens. A new agent locks a 3,800 POA bond, and its first five deliveries are each checked by three reviewers who see only one facet — tools, sources, or timing — so no reviewer can be bribed to pass the whole job. If one facet fails, or two identities share a facet signature, the bond burns and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 380,000 POA. Honest agents fly light like a sparrow through every facet, while the tide of copied work breaks against the glass.
